div.p: You've been fighting on Catachan longer than most of your squad has been alive. You've seen it all. The ambushes. The traps. The things that come out of the dark. You've lost more friends than you can count. You've got more scars than you have clean skin. And you're still here.

Experience is the only teacher that matters on a Death World. You've learned the hard way what works and what gets you killed. Your squad looks to you for wisdom, for leadership, for the knowledge that only comes from surviving when you shouldn't have. You've forgotten more about jungle warfare than most men will ever learn.
Pass on what you know. Keep them alive. That's your duty now.
Rock, Marbo, Arden, Jackson, Straken, Greiss, Ripper, Sly, Nork, Catachan
Choose one for each:
Hard Eyes, Dead Eyes, or Watchful Eyes
Peaked Cap, Shorn Hair, or Bandana
Sergeant's Insignia or Standard Gear
Built Body, Scarred Body, or Ravaged Body
You are Catachan, so you get this move.
When you survey the battlefield, even for a moment, and ask, "What here is the biggest threat?" the GM will tell you, honestly.
You start with these moves:
When you take action to inspire and protect your squad, roll+CHA. ✴On a 10+ you grant them +1 forward or remove one threat. ✴On a 7–9, they are inspired, but you draw the threat to yourself.
You ignore the clumsy tag on armor you wear.
When you give an order based on your authority and experience, roll+Cha. ✴On a 7+, they choose one:
✴On a 10+, you also take +1 forward against them. ✴On a miss, they do as they please and you take -1 forward against them.
When you dedicate yourself to a mission through planning and leadership, state what you set out to do:

ul.li: Eliminate _______, a great threat to the mission
Defend _______ from the threats that beset them

div.p: Then choose up to two boons:

ul.li: An unwavering sense of direction to _______.
Resistance to _______ (e.g., fire, poison, disease, etc.)
A freedom from fatigue and exhaustion

div.p: The GM will then tell you what requirement or requirements is needed of you to maintain your command:

ul.li: Valor (forbidden: suffering a threat to live)
Loyalty (required: support to those in need, no matter who they are)

div.p: Lead your squad to complete a mission objective.
Endanger yourself to protect someone weaker than you.
Your load is 12+Str. You start with rations (5 uses, 1 weight), carapace armor (2 armor, 3 weight), and some mark of your rank, describe it (0 weight). Choose your weapon:

ul.li: Lascarbine (near, far, 1 weight) and chainsword (close, 1 weight)
Lascarbine (near, far, 1 weight) and power sword (close, 1 weight)

div.p: Choose one:
Fill in the name of one of your companions in at least one:
_______________'s reckless behavior endangers the whole squad!
_______________ has stood by me in battle and can be trusted completely.
I respect the skills of _______________ but hope they will someday see the value of experience.
_______________ is a brave soul, I have much to learn from them.
When you gain a level from 2–5, choose from these moves.

You've learned from experience. Choose one specialization move. You can use that move as if it was a sergeant move. When you select this move, treat yourself as that specialization of level 1. Every time you gain a level thereafter, increase your effective specialization level by 1.

When you take damage you can grit your teeth and accept the blow. If you do you take no damage but instead suffer a debility of your choice. If you already have all six debilities you can't use this move.
While on a mission you deal +1d4 damage.

When you speak aloud your promise to defeat an enemy, you deal +2d4 damage against that enemy and -4 damage against anyone else. This effect lasts until the enemy is defeated. If you fail to defeat the enemy or give up the fight, you can admit your failure, but the effect continues until you find a way to redeem yourself.
When you lead the charge into combat, those you lead take +1 forward.
When you cover fire you always get +1 hold, even on a 6-.
When you close combat, choose an ally. Their next attack against your target does +1d4 damage.
You get +1 armor while on a mission.
Take +1 to request reinforcements.
When you treat an ally's wounds, you heal +1d8 damage.
When you gain a level from 6–10, choose from these moves or the level 2–5 moves.
Requires: Veteran Knowledge
When you see enemy tactics as they happen, you can ask the GM what their strategy is and its effects. Take +1 when acting on the answers.
Replaces: Mission Focus
While on a mission you deal +1d8 damage.
Replaces: Charge!
When you lead the charge into combat, those you lead take +1 forward and +2 armor forward.
Replaces: Staunch Defender

When you cover fire you always get +1 hold, even on a 6-. When you get a 12+ to cover fire instead of getting hold the nearest attacking creature is stymied giving you a clear advantage, the GM will describe it.
Replaces: Setup Strike
When you close combat, choose an ally. Their next attack against your target does +1d4 damage and they take +1 forward against them.
Replaces: Mission Protection
You get +2 armor while on a mission.
Replaces: Voice of Authority
Take +1 to request reinforcements. When you roll a 12+ the reinforcement transcends their moment of fear and doubt and carries out your order with particular effectiveness or efficiency.
Replaces: Field Medic
When you treat an ally's wounds, you heal +2d8 damage.
When you suffer a debility (even through Take the Hit) take +1 forward against whatever caused it.
When you mission command you choose three boons instead of two.

When you choose to go out in a blaze of glory at death's door, you give one final order that will be remembered forever. Your squad sees your sacrifice and is inspired beyond all measure. Roll+Cha. ✴On a 10+, your final command grants all allies +3 forward, +3 armor, and they may reroll any two dice for the rest of the battle. They deal +1d6 damage with all attacks. Your death becomes a rallying cry—they cannot fail while your memory drives them. The mission succeeds automatically. Your name becomes a legend, and future sergeants who know your story can invoke your memory once per mission to grant their squad +1 forward. ✴On a 7-9, your final command grants all allies +2 forward, +2 armor, and they may reroll one die for the rest of the battle. They deal +1d4 damage. ✴On a miss, your final words become a legend that echoes across Catachan. Your squad completes the mission in your name, and your sacrifice ensures their success. All allies take +2 forward, +1 armor, and deal +1d4 damage for the rest of the battle. Your name is remembered, and future squads take inspiration from your example—they gain +1 forward when they invoke your memory.
